exposure: The Revised American Fertility Society (R-AFS) score
Ovarian EMs combined with deep infiltrating endometriosis (DIE)
Elevated serum levels of cancer antigens
cohort: The study included 2,142 patients who underwent laparoscopic surgery for endometriosis at Fujian Provincial Maternal and Child Health Hospital from January 2014 to January 2018, and subsequently achieved pregnancy and delivery.
finding: The risk of placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) in patients with endometriosis increases with the R-AFS score, and PAS is more likely to occur in women with ovarian EMs combined with deep infiltrating endometriosis (DIE).
